setup.input_units: native; encoder units are twice the detents

steps.caption: Channel 1 plays the four-step phrase (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65 at velocities 127, 117, 107, 97) through a MIDI device on OUT 1, in C major at 90 BPM with sixteenth-note steps (Rate /1). Only Song slot 1 is filled. Song mode is Off, the global length is 32 steps (fader cell (4,7) on the Song page; Song Playback reads Global length 32) and playback is stopped. The norns shows channel 1's Device screen.
steps.title: Starting point

steps.caption: Close the menu and press Song at grid (6,8). Hold slot 1 at (1,1), press slot 2 at (2,1), then release both: slot 1 is copied to slot 2. Tap (2,1) to select slot 2. The top row now reads slot 1 mid-bright (filled), slot 2 bright (selected) and slot 3 dim (empty). The norns shows Slot setup for SONG 02 with the message Song sequence 2 selected.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

steps.title: Copy a populated slot

steps.caption: Turn E1 to Song tasks, turn E2 to Slot setup and press K3. Turn E3 up to Repeats 2 and press K3 to apply. Song mode is Off, so Repeats does not hold the slot for extra passes here; it only shows as the pass count on Song Playback.
steps.title: Give slot 2 Repeats 2

steps.caption: Press Song (6,8) and then Play at (1,8). Slot 2 plays the phrase C, D, E, F (MIDI 60, 62, 64, 65) and stays bright; slot 1 stays mid-bright and empty slot 3 stays dim. Song Playback reads Playing SONG 02, Pass 1 / 2, Song mode MANUAL.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

steps.title: Play the selected slot

steps.caption: Do these in order. 1: press Stop (1,8). 2: press Song (6,8) and select slot 1 at (1,1). 3: press Channel (3,8) and tap octave +1 at (11,8), so slot 1 sounds an octave higher. 4: press Song (6,8) again, select slot 2 at (2,1) and press Play (1,8). 5: while slot 2 sounds, press slot 1 at (1,1) to queue it. Slot 1 now blinks between dim and mid-bright (a still shows one moment of the blink) while slot 2 stays bright. Song mode is Off, so playback continues on slot 2 until one pass of its sequence ends.

assertion.characterisation: Characterisation outside README: populated queued slot alternates exact LED levels1/7 on the source0.4s blink clock; controlled samples are exactly0.4s apart. Real native visual dwell bounds derive from the20Hz grid flush plus the existing10ms clock allowance; fast observations do not assume the global blink phase.

steps.title: Queue slot 1 while slot 2 plays

steps.caption: Do nothing for about five seconds: slot 2 plays its full 32 steps (32 steps at one sixth of a second each). Slot 1 then becomes bright and plays its phrase an octave higher (MIDI 72, 74, 76, 77); slot 2 returns to mid-bright. Press Stop at (1,8). Song Playback reads Playing SONG 01.
steps.title: Hear the queued slot take over

steps.caption: With playback stopped, hold empty slot 3 at (3,1), press slot 2 at (2,1) and release: the empty slot is copied over slot 2 and erases it. Tap slot 1 at (1,1). Slot 1 is bright; slots 2 and 3 are both dim. There is no undo.

assertion.characterisation: Stopped selected slot is also bright (outside the README playing-only wording).

steps.title: Erase by copying an empty slot
